search_performance_calibration.prior_statement: 60fps guaranteed across all devices based on <1ms benchmark
search_performance_calibration.rationale: In-memory token search consumes <1ms CPU time on standard JVM/ART, but physical 60fps rendering depends on Compose/SwiftUI layout complexity, font rendering, and hardware display refresh rates. Device profiling on real hardware is scheduled for QA phase.

offline_resilience_calibration.rationale: Once catalog items are loaded into runtime memory, searching, filtering, and detail navigation are 100% network-independent. However, initial cold launch without network remains unavailable until persistent storage (Room / SwiftData) is introduced in M14.
